note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground on the south dyke of Gleniffer Reservoir (the Dickson Dam impoundment of the Red Deer River): spacious sites sheltered by mixed forest, near a beach and boat launch. No water on site and no firewood sold; wood is sold at Spruce View Co-op (off Hwy 54) or Innisfail. --Claude
